page.layout: One page of text, one block: a heading at full width at the top, then the running text below it. Faint show-through and stains in the lower half; a catchword-like mark at lower right is part of the damaged print and is not transcribed as text.

main_text.head: AD LECTOREM.
main_text.p: clesia, cui totam doctrinam Apostoli Petrus & Paulus cum sanguine suo profuderunt. Hæc ex animo scripta, ut in animum demittas, te, per spes tuas & per quidquid carum est, Lector rogo.

page.notes: The first word is partly lost to damage at the left edge; read as "clesia" (Ecclesia) with the E missing from the scan. The faint lines in the middle and lower page are show-through from the reverse side and are not transcribed. The marks "TY" at lower right and the small fragment near the lower left are illegible print or stains: [illegible, ~2 letters] at lower right.
